head: codex/18-csdlc-schema-broken-pipe
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Handle closed machine-output pipes
body:
Closes #18

## Summary
- adds a shared JSON stdout writer that treats only BrokenPipe as normal downstream termination
- routes schema, success, and typed error payloads from both split GitHub binaries through that writer
- adds process-level early-close coverage and direct writer error-classification tests
- documents the machine-readable output termination contract

## Validation
- focused library and GitHub action tests: 49 passed
- strict warning-denied Clippy: PASS
- typed finalize and doctor: PASS
- independent exact-head review: PASS, no actionable findings

## Boundary
- bounded to csdlc-github-issue and csdlc-github-pr plus the reusable shared writer
- unrelated C-SDLC binaries retain their existing output paths
- no GitHub action semantics or schema changes
- no AWS
